events.problem: GA-1201A tripped on VSHH-1201 high vibration 7.4 mm/s
events.root_cause: Angular misalignment 0.12 mm/100mm after foundation settlement
events.action: Laser re-aligned pump/motor, re-shimmed motor feet, vibration back to 1.9 mm/s

events.problem: Hairline crack in epoxy grout under baseplate edge
events.root_cause: Vibration-induced grout fatigue at pump end
events.action: Chipped out loose grout and re-grouted with epoxy, torqued hold-down bolts

events.problem: Bearing DE noisy with rising temperature TI-1201 trend
events.root_cause: Outer race spalling on DE bearing due to prolonged misalignment
events.action: Renewed DE bearing 7310 BECBM, flushed housing, refilled ISO VG 68

events.problem: Abnormal noise from coupling area, guard vibration
events.root_cause: Rexnord coupling element cracked from repeated misalignment cycles
events.action: Replaced coupling spacer element, re-aligned, re-fit guard

links.rationale: structural support is a known consequence of misalignment; shared term(s): vibration

steps.text:
Step   Action   Check / Acceptance
1   Isolate and LOTO the motor, remove coupling guard   Isolation & LOTO verified
2   Mount laser alignment brackets across the coupling spacer   Parts match BOM / spec
3   Rotate 0-90-180-270 deg and capture readings   Torque / clearance to spec
4   Target angular < 0.05 mm/100 mm and offset < 0.05 mm   No leak / smooth operation
5   Add/remove shims under motor feet, re-check, and record the alignment report   Record in equipment history

Step   Action   Check / Acceptance
1   Record VT-1201 on the daily PdM route in mm/s RMS   Loop isolated / under permit
2   Note alarm at 4.5 mm/s and trip at 7.1 mm/s (VSHH-1201)   Reference standard traceable
3   A rise greater than 1 mm/s within a week = plan a bearing inspection   As-found & as-left recorded
4   Correlate the vibration rise with TI-1201 bearing temperature   Trip / control action verified
5   Escalate to reliability engineer if the 1x running-speed component dominates   Return to service confirmed

Step   Action   Check / Acceptance
1   Open the suction valve fully and vent the casing air via N5 vent   Permit valid & briefed
2   Establish seal flush Plan 11 and confirm PDI-1201 dP   Parameter within limit
3   Confirm the min-flow recycle line FV-1201 is open   Interlock status confirmed
4   Bump-start the motor and check correct rotation direction   Change logged on DCS
5   Start the motor and confirm PIC-1201 pressure and vibration settle within 5 s   Handover to next shift

events.problem: High tube dP PDT-5605, low solvent outlet temperature
events.root_cause: Hexane fouling / polymer fines deposit on tube bores
events.action: Hydrojetted 246 tubes, restored dP and duty, re-gasketed

events.problem: Water found in solvent, rising outlet temperature
events.root_cause: Two tubes leaking at tube-to-tubesheet joint
events.action: Located and plugged 2 tubes both ends, hydrotest passed

links.rationale: tube leak is a known consequence of fouling; shared term(s): plugged

knowledge_links.title: Tube Leak Detection & Plugging
knowledge_links.source_path: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/87223855-0a75-5709-b12f-32624d036336/scratchpad/case1/Case 1_ Manufacturing Knowledge Hub/Set_05_EA-5601_SOLVENT_HEATER/OPL (One Point Lessons)/OPL-EA-5601-05 - Tube_Leak_Detection_Plugging.pdf

steps.text:
Step   Action   Check / Acceptance
1   Isolate and hydrotest the shell side to find the leak   Isolation & LOTO verified
2   Bubble-test to identify the specific leaking tube   Parts match BOM / spec
3   Plug both ends of the tube with tapered plugs   Torque / clearance to spec
4   Record the plugged-tube count (maximum 5 % of tubes)   No leak / smooth operation
5   Plan bundle replacement if the plugging limit is reached   Record in equipment history

knowledge_links.title: Tube-Side Cleaning (Hydrojetting)
knowledge_links.source_path: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/87223855-0a75-5709-b12f-32624d036336/scratchpad/case1/Case 1_ Manufacturing Knowledge Hub/Set_05_EA-5601_SOLVENT_HEATER/OPL (One Point Lessons)/OPL-EA-5601-01 - Tube_Side_Cleaning_Hydrojetting.pdf

steps.text:
Step   Action   Check / Acceptance
1   Isolate and drain both sides, then purge with nitrogen   Isolation & LOTO verified
2   Open the channel cover and remove the old gasket   Parts match BOM / spec
3   Hydrojet the tube bores and inspect for pitting/erosion   Torque / clearance to spec
4   Verify tube-side dP restored and no residual blockage   No leak / smooth operation
5   Re-gasket with new SW SS316 gasket and box up to torque   Record in equipment history

Step   Action   Check / Acceptance
1   Log PDT-5605 differential pressure weekly   Loop isolated / under permit
2   Note the PDAH-5605 fouling alarm at 0.7 bar dP   Reference standard traceable
3   Correlate rising dP with any outlet-temperature shortfall   As-found & as-left recorded
4   Plan cleaning before the duty loss becomes critical   Trip / control action verified
5   Feed the trend into the exchanger cleaning program   Return to service confirmed

events.problem: PDI-1201 reading erratic, seal-flush low alarm nuisance-tripping
events.root_cause: Impulse lines fouled with hexane residue/polymer fines
events.action: Cleaned impulse lines and re-zeroed PDI-1201 transmitter

events.problem: Hexane leak observed at GA-1201A seal gland during operation, seal drain flowing
events.root_cause: API Plan 11 flush orifice RO-1201 partially plugged causing seal face to run dry and score
events.action: Replaced JC T2100 mechanical seal cartridge, cleaned flush orifice, verified PDI-1201 dP

steps.text:
Step   Action   Check / Acceptance
1   Line up discharge flush to seal chamber and open flush isolation   Isolation & LOTO verified
2   Check PDI-1201 reads 1.5-2.5 bar dP across the flush orifice RO-1201   Parts match BOM / spec
3   Verify no visible leak or drip at the gland / seal drain   Torque / clearance to spec
4   If dP low, isolate and inspect orifice RO-1201 for plugging by polymer/dirt   No leak / smooth operation
5   Confirm quench (Plan 62) N2/steam is lined up to the outboard side   Record in equipment history
